name: 屈光度（焦距换算）计算器

map.由焦距（米）按 P = 1/f 计算透镜屈光度（D）。: From the focal length (in meters), compute the lens diopter (D) using P = 1/f.
map.屈光度单位 D = m⁻¹；凸透镜 P>0（远视/老花），凹透镜 P<0（近视）: Diopter unit D = m⁻¹; convex lens P>0 (hyperopia/presbyopia), concave lens P<0 (myopia).
map.由焦距（米）算屈光度 D=1/f。: From the focal length (meters), compute the diopter D=1/f.
map.凸透镜正、凹透镜负。: Convex is positive, concave is negative.
map.焦距 f=0.1m（10cm 凸透镜）→ D=1/0.1=+10.00D；f=−: Focal length f=0.1m (10cm convex lens) → D=1/0.1=+10.00D; f=−0.25m concave lens → −4.00D.
map.两片薄透镜贴合同轴，总 D=D₁+D₂；+2.00 叠 −1.00 → +1.0: Two thin lenses in close contact and coaxial: total D=D₁+D₂; +2.00 combined with −1.00 → +1.00D, equivalent to a single lens.
map.薄透镜紧密贴合且同轴时屈光度相加；有间距要计入分离效应。: Thin lenses in close contact and coaxial have their diopters added; when separated, the separation effect must be included.
